label: anthropic
note: Cloud mode: LLM_PROVIDER=auto with GETNET_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> claude-haiku-5-5; embeddings local nomic-embed-text; budget 30 s. Critic calibrated (material problems only, today's date) after run anthropic-critic-v1. D9 runs in the ollama report.
method: Wall-clock latency of POST /api/chat (demo bearer token), fresh session per latency request, user_id cliente1988, 2 s pause before each request. cold = all Ollama models unloaded before each request; warm = models resident. Latency mean/p95 use llm_complete responses only; fallbacks and errors are not successes.
outcome_definition:
llm_complete | fallback_budget | fallback_error | http_error.

    Only llm_complete counts as success: every model step the route needs ran
    and returned a valid result. Deterministic policy outcomes (clarification,
    handoff, safety) after a successful contextual model call are complete.
